functions.name: ScreenPointToRay
functions.doc: The ray from `camera` through `point`, in window pixels from the top-left of its target.

returns.doc: Whether there is a ray: false with no renderer or no such camera.

parameters.name: ray
parameters.doc: The ray; the default ray when there is none.

functions.name: WorldToScreenPoint
functions.doc: Where `point`, in world space, lands on `camera`'s target, in window pixels from its top-left.

returns.doc: Whether it lands: false with no renderer, no such camera, or a point behind the camera.

parameters.name: screenPoint
parameters.doc: The point; zero when it does not land.

functions.name: CameraAt
functions.doc: The camera whose view of `window` is under `point`, in window pixels from its top-left.

returns.doc: The camera entity, or no entity (C#'s Entity.None).

functions.name: GetWorldBounds
functions.doc: The world-space box around the meshes of `entity` and its children.

returns.doc: Whether there is one: false with no renderer, an entity not alive, or no mesh to bound.

parameters.name: bounds
parameters.doc: The box; the default box when there is none.

functions.name: Stats
functions.doc: What the renderer did in the last frame.

returns.doc: Whether the app has a renderer.

parameters.name: stats
parameters.doc: The counts; zero with no renderer.

functions.name: SpawnModel
functions.doc: Spawns `model` into the active scene as SpawnModel does, under `parent` unless it is no entity: recorded, so it takes effect when the system returns.

returns.doc: The model's root entity, or no entity (C#'s Entity.None) with no asset store, a stale model or a parent that is not alive.

parameters.name: model
parameters.doc: The model's handle, packed as Fenrir.Assets packs one (generation high, index low).
